integrity.proof_basis: Explicit frequency-supremum reduction and a monotone scalar optimization; finite diagnostics supplementary.
integrity.proof_scope: All finite dimensions and all integer arities at least two, with no finite-enumeration inference.

scientific_limitations: The exact constant covers the isotropic Japanese-bracket weight on finite-dimensional integer tori, smoothness s>=0, and arbitrary multilinear arity m>=2.
Single-character extremal frequencies are classified; arbitrary Fourier-mixture extremizers and sharp diagonal power constants for m>=4 are not classified.
The Euclidean comparison is a lower bound and does not determine the exact Euclidean multilinear norm.
Publication priority remains subject to independent verification, especially for older weighted-convolution literature.
title: Sharp arity saturation for multiplication in periodic spectral Barron spaces
